Deviload 2.6.6 fixes the yt-dlp update button staying busy indefinitely.

- Limit the updater process to two minutes and version checks to 15 seconds. If the connection stalls, stop the updater and show an error so you can retry.
- Share one update operation between manual and automatic requests, and prevent overlapping updater processes.
- Show an explicit updating state, restore the buttons after an error and dismiss the outdated-engine notice after a successful update.
- Refresh the project README with platform download links, support buttons and the current infernal mascot.

Your download history, library and settings stay in place.

Accept the update prompt in Deviload on Windows, macOS or AppImage. For the Windows portable build or Debian package, download the matching file from this release. The macOS test build remains unsigned by Apple.

Full changelog: https://github.com/Pronexsteam/deviload/compare/v2.6.5...v2.6.6
